title: Understanding the Models
text: The first model uses the original design matrix X, while the second model uses the mean-centered design matrix Ẋ. This affects the predictions as λ approaches $$\infty$$.

title: Effect of Regularization
text: As λ approaches $$\infty$$, the regularization term dominates the cost function, pushing the coefficients towards zero.

title: Predictions with Large λ
text: With large λ, the coefficients θ shrink towards zero, leading the predictions to also approach zero.

title: Final Prediction Value
text: What value do the predictions of the first model approach as λ approaches positive $$\infty$$?
choices: the mean of the true $$y$$ values
